scenarios.expected: A consented OAuth callback returns to the initiating tab without exposing the callback to another profile.
scenarios.notes: The exact release press gate includes the desktop OAuth suite; this row does not generalize to every identity provider.

scenarios.expected: After consent, an installed external application may receive its registered login callback.
scenarios.notes: The press gate exercised the external-link callback flow on macOS.

scenarios.expected: A site-opened authentication popup remains focused and tied to its opener family.
scenarios.notes: No release-tagged cross-platform focused-popup result has been recorded yet.

scenarios.expected: A site can use a camera only after Blanc's explicit permission flow and applicable OS consent.
scenarios.notes: Packaged media-permission gates passed; hardware-specific end-to-end camera capture was not recorded on every platform.

scenarios.expected: A site can use a microphone only after Blanc's explicit permission flow and applicable OS consent.
scenarios.notes: Packaged media-permission gates passed; hardware-specific audio capture was not recorded on every platform.

scenarios.expected: A site receives only the screen or window the user chooses in Blanc's picker.
scenarios.notes: Release media gates cover picker wiring; a full hardware/display matrix remains to be run.

scenarios.expected: System audio is shared only when the selected source and operating system support it and the user requests it.
scenarios.notes: The packaged permission path is covered; device- and OS-specific audio output was not recorded for all platforms.

scenarios.expected: The signed app carries the profile and entitlement required for platform passkeys.
scenarios.notes: Packaging and signature evidence passed; this row does not claim a fresh live passkey ceremony on every relying party.

scenarios.expected: A user-invoked fill can request a matching Login item from the installed 1Password app.
scenarios.notes: No exact-v1.21 live installed-app result is recorded in the release incident.

scenarios.expected: Commercial DRM playback that requires a separately provisioned content-decryption module is not promised.
scenarios.notes: Blanc does not publish Widevine support; this is not authorization to add DRM.

scenarios.expected: Ordinary formats supported by the bundled Electron runtime play through Chromium media elements.
scenarios.notes: Native media smoke passed; representative public media sites still need release-tagged manual results.

scenarios.expected: Installing a website as a standalone operating-system application is not provided.
scenarios.notes: Blanc is a browser shell without a PWA installation surface.

scenarios.expected: A user-initiated download appears in Blanc Downloads and the selected file remains on disk.
scenarios.notes: Implementation exists, but the v1.21 release record does not contain a dedicated cross-platform download result.

scenarios.expected: A file input opens the native picker and supplies only files chosen by the user.
scenarios.notes: No exact-v1.21 cross-platform upload evidence has been recorded.

scenarios.expected: A user-selected local HTML document opens without granting arbitrary local-file access to websites.
scenarios.notes: Desktop and unit coverage passed in the press gate; packaged per-platform manual coverage remains incomplete.

scenarios.expected: The packaged app can participate in the operating system's default-browser registration flow.
scenarios.notes: The exact release native jobs passed their browser-registration gates; user selection remains controlled by the operating system.

scenarios.expected: An operating-system web link handed to Blanc opens in a managed tab.
scenarios.notes: The press gate exercised external-link activation on macOS.

scenarios.expected: Representative productivity sites complete their core signed-in workflows.
scenarios.notes: Sites and accounts must be named in private test operations; public results will remain aggregate and browsing-content free.

scenarios.expected: Representative banking sign-in and account-navigation flows work without recording credentials or account content.
scenarios.notes: No public aggregate result exists yet.

scenarios.expected: Representative storefront, cart, and checkout-entry flows work without publishing purchase details.
scenarios.notes: No public aggregate result exists yet.

scenarios.expected: Representative developer documentation and authenticated tool workflows work.
scenarios.notes: No public aggregate result exists yet.
